map.支持直齿/斜齿标准圆柱齿轮基本参数计算（GB/T 1356）: Supports basic parameter calculation for standard spur/helical cylindrical gears (GB/T 1356)
map.📖 查看「标准齿轮参数计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Standard Gear Parameter Calculator Guide"
map.💡 公式：分度圆 d=mz；基圆 db=d·cosα；齿顶圆 da=d+2ha；: 💡 Formula: pitch circle d=mz; base circle db=d·cosα; addendum circle da=d+2ha; dedendum circle df=d-2hf; circular pitch p=πm. Helical gears are computed with the normal module mn.
map.本工具适用于标准渐开线圆柱齿轮（正常齿制 ha*=1, c*=0.25）: This tool applies to standard involute cylindrical gears (standard tooth system ha*=1, c*=0.25)
map.斜齿轮输入法向模数 mn，螺旋角 β 不可为 0: For helical gears enter the normal module mn; the helix angle β cannot be 0
map.标准齿轮不发生根切的最少齿数：直齿 zmin=17，斜齿 zmin=17·cos: Minimum number of teeth to avoid undercutting for standard gears: spur zmin=17, helical zmin=17·cos³β
map.计算结果仅供参考，实际设计请查阅 GB/T 1356 标准: Results are for reference only; for actual design consult the GB/T 1356 standard
map.输入模数、齿数、压力角，输出全套齿轮几何（分度圆、基圆、齿顶/根圆、齿厚、基节）: Enter the module, number of teeth and pressure angle to output the full gear geometry (pitch circle, base circle, addendum/dedendum circles, tooth thickness, base pitch).
map.直齿与斜齿切换（端面模数、基节）。: Switch between spur and helical (transverse module, base pitch).
map.法向模数 2、β=20°：mt=2/cos20°=2.128、pt=π·mt=6: Normal module 2, β=20°: mt=2/cos20°=2.128, pt=π·mt=6.685, pb=pt·cosα.
map.基节 pb 与周节 p 关系？: What is the relationship between the base pitch pb and the circular pitch p?
map.pb=p·cosα，是相邻齿同侧齿廓在基圆上的法向距离，等于重合度计算的齿距投影: pb=p·cosα, the normal distance between adjacent same-side tooth profiles on the base circle, equal to the pitch projection used in contact-ratio calculation.
map.本工具默认 m=2、α=20°（最常用），可改；斜齿需额外输入螺旋角。: This tool defaults to m=2 and α=20° (the most common) and both can be changed; helical gears also require the helix angle.
